title: The morphism given by a bijective reordering of the coordinate sections is invertible
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\beta,\gamma$ be coordinate types, and let $b:\gamma\simeq\beta$ be an equivalence. Write $X=\mathbb P(\beta;S)$ [def-pc-proj], $M=(\operatorname{id}_X)^*\mathcal O_X(1)$ [def-pc-module-pullback, def-pc-projective-space-twist], $s_j=(\operatorname{id}_X)^*T_{b(j)}$, and $U_j=D_+(T_{b(j)})$. The morphism $\phi:X\to\mathbb P(\gamma;S)$ constructed by the native homOfIsFreeGenerator from the sections $s_j$, their free-generator witnesses on $U_j$, and the cover $\bigcup_j U_j=X$, over the structure morphism $X\to S$, is an isomorphism. No finiteness or nonemptiness assumption on the coordinate types is required.

source.place: Constructions Definition 01NF and Lemma 01NE: projective-space charts and coordinate construction, applied to bijective renaming and its inverse.

proof.text: Inside the proof, derive the normalized homOfSections rule when s_i = 1 from homOfSections_resLE_standardOpenIso_hom and eq_divBasicOpen. The basic open of 1 is top, so its inclusion is an isomorphism and may be cancelled. Apply this to the family on the relative affine space with 1 in position i and the affine coordinates elsewhere. homOfSections_appLE_coordRatio then identifies the pullback of each coordinate ratio under the inverse chart inclusion with the affine coordinate. This establishes the chart-coordinate identity over arbitrary S without restriction to an affine base.

Restrict the native homOfIsFreeGenerator to standardOpen beta S (b i) using ι_homOfIsFreeGenerator. By pullbackSection_twistOneSection_map_eq_smul for the identity morphism and uniqueness of coefficients of a free generator, sectionRatio i j equals coordRatio (b i) (b j). The normalized rule and the chart-coordinate identity now identify this restriction with the source chart isomorphism, AffineSpace.reindex on the complementary coordinate types, and the inverse target chart inclusion. The base maps agree by the native over lemmas; equality of all coordinates gives equality by AffineSpace.hom_ext.

Construct psi with the same native homOfIsFreeGenerator formula for b.symm. On the standard-open cover indexed by gamma, substitute both chart restriction formulas into phi followed by psi and cancel the middle chart isomorphisms. The composite affine reindexing fixes the base and every coordinate because b (b.symm j) = j; AffineSpace.hom_ext makes it the identity. Scheme.Opens.hom_ext_of_iSup_eq_top makes the global composite the identity. Repeat on the cover indexed by beta using b.symm (b j) = j for the other composite. The pair gives an IsIso witness. No new gluing or tensor-pullback comparison is used. For empty types the covering equality still applies, and for singleton types the complementary coordinate type is empty, so affine hom_ext uses just the base-map equality.
